manufacturer.name: DoorKing
manufacturer.note: US manufacturer of vehicular gate operators and access control. Publishes owner's manuals on its own domain with a document code and revision in the filename. Its manuals sit in a WordPress uploads tree under a consistent naming scheme - <model>-065-<revision letter>-<month>-<year>.pdf - which makes both the revision and its date readable from the URL alone. That tree is registered as a harvest target.
